verdict.rationale: Orb documents its own migration path from Stripe Billing, covering subscription types, historical event backfills, and running in parallel with Stripe while you validate invoices. That parallel run supports a cutover customers don't notice. Subscriptions can also be created programmatically via the API, but there is no documented spreadsheet/CSV import and no evidence of PCI-compliant card data transfer. missing for 10: spreadsheet/CSV bulk import of live subscriptions, PCI-compliant payment card/token transfer, migration from platforms other than Stripe, documented customer-invisible cutover mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: Orb supports a seamless migration from Stripe Billing, whether you're using flat-rate subscriptions, usage-based pricing, pricing on seats, or you've implemented custom billing logic.
Orb can operate in parallel with your existing Stripe Billing implementation while you validate data and invoices.
Orb is fundamentally architected to support event backfills, which makes it easy to replay historical usage and ensure that your billing setup is accurate before migrating to Orb.
